author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: dst_rst_n is combinational logic over rst_req_q (clk_a) and asynchronously resets q_q in asynchronous clk_b: RDC-007 ERROR Established. hold_i has a set_input_delay so RDC-002 is exempt.

author_reading.rationale: clk_b async reset is generated by combinational logic from rst_req_q, a register in asynchronous clk_a.

labels.rationale: The asynchronous reset of q_q is driven by logic with a clk_a register leaf. With hold_i low, reset can deassert independently of the asynchronous receiving clock clk_b.

Asynchronous reset net dst_rst_n = ~(rst_req_q & ~hold_i) (design.sv:16) resets q_q in the clk_b domain (design.sv:18) but is driven by register rst_req_q clocked in the asynchronous clk_a domain (design.sv:14), creating an unsynchronized cross-domain asynchronous reset assertion/deassertion hazard (RDC-007 ERROR Established).

settlement.rationale: dst_rst_n is combinational logic over rst_req_q (clk_a) and asynchronously resets q_q in asynchronous clk_b: RDC-007 ERROR Established. hold_i has a set_input_delay so RDC-002 is exempt.
